description: Saves something to keep in mind from now on, in a few words ("Left knee hurts on deep squats", "Goal: 10K in April", "No dairy"). Never medical history: no conditions, diagnoses, medications or surgeries. With id and version, replaces that one. The person sees it in the app, can delete it, and can undo it in Changes.
name: trainrec_remember
title: Remember for every chat
